modules.name: core
open_issues: No critic gauntlet has run — core is infrastructure (ECS, event bus, RNG, renderer bootstrap, module isolation) and is not itself visually scored, but its API surface should be reviewed once more modules exist.

modules.name: environment
open_issues: No critic gauntlet has run yet — manual verification only (see docs/critique/v0.0.1.md).
Sky turbidity/rayleigh/mie values are rough guesses, not tuned against reference lighting.
No horizon detail, atmospheric haze layer, clouds, or starfield.
Ground material is a deterministic-noise placeholder, not a real PBR material set (that's materials/terrain's job).

history.summary: Bootstrap: PROMPT.md, README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/STATUS.json, scripts/release.sh (+tests), .gitignore, ASSETS.md, and a minimal core+environment scaffold (ECS, event bus, seeded RNG, module isolation, a physically-based sky/sun/ground boot scene) with the tools/verify/screenshot.mjs verification loop. No builder/critic gauntlet has run — docs and tooling only, as anticipated for v0.0.1.
